case_name: Shreya Singhal v. Union of India
scope_note: Section 66A of the Information Technology Act, 2000 struck down in its entirety as violative of Article 19(1)(a) and not saved by Article 19(2).

case_name: Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India
scope_note: Read down: section 377 no longer criminalises consensual sexual conduct between adults in private; it continues to apply to non-consensual acts, acts involving minors, and bestiality.

case_name: Joseph Shine v. Union of India
scope_note: Section 497 (adultery) struck down as violative of Articles 14, 15 and 21; section 198(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 struck down to the extent it applies to section 497.

case_name: S.G. Vombatkere v. Union of India
scope_note: Interim order in W.P.(C) No. 682 of 2021: pending trials, appeals and proceedings on a charge under section 124A kept in abeyance, and Governments expected to refrain from registering FIRs under section 124A, while the provision is re-examined.
